corrections.problem: explicit blob fetch negotiated unavailable tree objects
corrections.fix: use Git v2.43 promisor-fetch negotiationAlgorithm=noop; validated on synthetic partial clone

corrections.problem: test-only parameter removal could consume its containing closing parenthesis and production body
corrections.fix: preserve containing closing delimiters; regression failed first, then passed; all earlier scans invalidated and refreshed by scanner digest

corrections.problem: Git client error processing shallow info: 4 after three same-mechanism retries
corrections.fix: full commits-only default-branch clone, still tree:0 and no-checkout; count exact same window; this is not a GitHub rate-limit bypass

corrections.problem: repository source contains an in-tree Rust file symlink; blanket rejection could not scan it
corrections.fix: resolve pinned Git file-link chains, reject escaping/missing/cyclic targets, materialize targets without executing filters, canonicalize source and inspect linked manifests; synthetic partial-clone and escape rejection checks pass

corrections.problem: whole-repository Rust scans can read >100 MB even when forbidden normal dependencies already disqualify the repository
corrections.fix: materialize all manifests first; evaluate the identical forbidden-dependency condition first; fetch and scan Rust only when it remains necessary; update diagnostic first-reason order and refresh all earlier scan rows under current scanner digest; keep predicate unchanged

corrections.problem: an unresolved inherited alias aborted a repository that independently has resolved forbidden normal dependencies
corrections.fix: collect unresolved aliases while resolving all manifests; return proven forbidden dependencies if any; otherwise reject unresolved inheritance visibly. Regression covers both cases; no unknown can become a survivor.

corrections.problem: one Cargo.toml cannot be parsed strictly (duplicate value), so its dependencies cannot be verified mechanically
corrections.decision: Conservative pre-registration narrowing: every Cargo.toml must be UTF-8 and parse strictly under tomllib; otherwise explicit unscannable-manifest exclusion, no repair/omission/build-failure claim. Other own-parser/invariant errors remain visible failures.

corrections.problem: resuming an unfinished candidate reused its immutable metadata response but labeled its observation with resume time
corrections.fix: derive observed_utc from the original successful API manifest request-start, and link response URL/SHA-256 directly in every candidate row; rebuild from caches, changing no selection counts, pins, source results or pool.
